# Tacotron 2 + WaveGlow (NVIDIA)

NVIDIA · released 2018

Exact NVIDIA implementation with WaveGlow vocoder. Do not transfer these listening-study values to Coqui, SpeechBrain, HiFi-GAN or a differently trained checkpoint. Historical run dependencies documented upstream; no current one-command run verified.

[Model and usage documentation](https://github.com/NVIDIA/DeepLearningExamples/tree/729963dd47e7c8bd462ad10bfac7a7b0b604e6dd/PyTorch/SpeechSynthesis/FastPitch)
